description: Before or after upgrading dependencies — package.json / lockfile / requirements changes, npm update, pip install -U, a Gradle version catalog, go.mod, a workflow's actions — pass each package with the version you run and the version you are moving to. Returns every tracked release in between with the vendor's own breaking-change, deprecation, migration and security sections verbatim, the categorized change list, CVE ids and deterministic signals (major bump, removed/deprecated items, breaking mentions) — including breaking changes shipped in minor or patch versions. Pass repository (from the package's own package.json) for scoped or renamed packages; it makes the match exact. A Maven/Gradle, Go, NuGet or GitHub Actions package goes by its purl (e.g. pkg:maven/com.squareup.okhttp3/okhttp), or by its own coordinate as the name (group:artifact, a module path, owner/repo@ref), and is matched exactly or not at all. A Maven, Go or NuGet package this server does not track is checked against deps.dev after the answer and counted, to decide what to track next; pass recordMisses: false for private packages.

dependencies.description: Up to 20 per call; split a larger upgrade.

from.description: The version installed now — a version, not a range: read it from the lockfile.

name.description: The package as its ecosystem spells it: "better-auth", "@tanstack/react-query", a Maven "group:artifact", a Go module path, or an Action's "owner/repo@ref".

purl.description: The package as a purl (package URL), e.g. "pkg:maven/com.squareup.okhttp3/okhttp", "pkg:golang/github.com/spf13/cobra" or "pkg:nuget/Newtonsoft.Json" — what an SBOM, OSV or Renovate already names it by. Takes precedence over name and registry; a version inside it is ignored in favour of the versions passed beside it.

registry.description: Default npm — unless purl, or the name's own shape (group:artifact, a Go module path), says otherwise.

repository.description: The package's source repository — its package.json `repository`, or the repo a Maven or NuGet package is built from (any GitHub URL, github:owner/repo or owner/repo). Resolves scoped and renamed packages the name alone cannot, and makes the match exact.

to.description: The version being moved to. Omit for everything after `from` that is tracked.

recordMisses.description: Default true. A Maven, Go or NuGet package this server does not track is checked against deps.dev after the answer and counted per day, with nothing about the caller, to decide what to track next. Pass false for private packages.

name: upgrade_notes

changes.description: Every categorized change across the interval, merged across releases, removed/deprecated/security first.

synthesized.description: Summarized from commit messages because the vendor published no notes.

versions.description: The versions that shipped it, newest first — several when a fix landed on more than one branch.

compareMarkdownUrl.description: The same interval as markdown, with every release's notes.

compareUrl.description: The interval as one page on What's New.

ahead.description: `from` is newer than anything we track.

tracked.description: Whether this exact version is in the history we hold.

url.description: The release's page here, when tracked.

to.description: Absent when the call named no `to`.

tracked.description: Whether this exact version is in the history we hold.

url.description: The release's page here, when tracked.

truncated.description: `from` sits below the history we hold, so `releases` is a lower bound.

unordered.description: Rows the comparator could not place against it.

tier.description: identifier: a registry id, a purl or a repository the catalog tracks. namespace: the package sits under a namespace the product claims (a Maven group, say) — the notes are the family's. name: a name-only guess — check the product before trusting it, and pass purl or repository to make it exact.

url.description: The product's page on What's New.

notes.description: How the package and its versions were resolved, and what was cut.

purl.description: The package as a versionless purl, as it was matched.

registry.description: The registry, when the package is in one of these four; absent for a Maven, Go, NuGet or Actions package.

breakingMention.description: The vendor's own words say “breaking change”.

labels.description: Provenance to keep with any quote, e.g. “Sample data”.

notesOmitted.description: Past the per-call body budget: listed by version only; the permalink has the notes.

records.description: Typed change records: what a user may have to change, by kind (ADR 2026-11.64f9). Model-extracted and labelled; never a verdict that the release breaks anything.

evidence.description: The bullet or paragraph the record comes from, verbatim from the vendor's notes. Absent past the call's evidence budget.

label.description: Who says so, to keep with the record: e.g. “inferred by a model”.

package.description: In a monorepo's notes, the package it is about.

removalPlanned.description: For a deprecation, when the vendor says it goes.

subject.description: The API, flag, key or platform it is about.

tier.description: headed: under the vendor's own breaking / deprecation / migration / security heading. inferred: a model read it from the notes' prose and a second model call confirmed it. declared: from a Declarative Changelog release, read the same way.

recordsOmitted.description: The call's record budget left some out; the permalink has them.

sections.description: What the vendor filed under its own breaking / security / deprecation / migration headings.

truncated.description: Cut at the cap; the release's permalink has it whole.

under.description: The heading this section sits under — in a monorepo's release note, the package it is about.

sectionsOmitted.description: A budget cut a section or left one out; the permalink has them all.

sourceUrl.description: The vendor's own release notes; present when the notes were read.

url.description: This release's page on What's New.

signals.description: Over every release in the interval. Deterministic: a SemVer major bump, the vendor's literal “breaking” wording, CVE ids. Model-derived, from what was stored when each release arrived: the removed / deprecated / security categories and the typed change records.

records.description: User-facing typed change records across the interval, by kind; absent when none are stored.

inferred.description: Of the total, read from prose rather than a heading.

status.description: ok answers; untracked is not in the catalog; unreadable is a from/to the version grammar cannot read (a range is not a version); the rest name why the pair has no interval.

uncategorized.description: Versions in the interval with no categorized changes.

title: Review a dependency upgrade
